featured_reviews.name: Sushant Garle
featured_reviews.review_text:
Gurdwara Sri Guru Nanak Darbar located at Sher-E-Punjab is an extremely peaceful and hygienic place which also has a beautiful ground for people to jog in the morning as well as in the evening and people can come and rest and observe the beauty of nature.Shri Guru Nanak Gurudwara, sher-e-punjab is a holy place for shiks. We can get piece of mind and pre to god with all egos surrendered.
The moment you enter, the positive energy we can feel. Some rule we have to follow strictly here. First remove your footwear then wash your hands and foots. Before you go pray hall  cover head with cloth. Very big pray hall where kirtan on regular basis is going on. Sit for some time and offer you pray to God from bottom of heart.Lunger ie regular activity in gurdwara. Many religious functions and activities are held here .Maintained well, clean. People are polite here. For travellers & saints it's best place ever. Gurudwara has staying facility and rates are very low as compare to others. You can give as per ability less or more as you can. Finally it's God House. Outside also clean and located on main road. You can enjoy outside street food is very delicious and hygienic.

featured_reviews.name: Rajat Bajaj
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visiting the Dadar Gurudwara on the sacred occasion of Gurupurab was a deeply soothing and spiritual experience. The peaceful ambience, soulful Gurbani, and beautifully done decoration created an atmosphere of serenity and devotion. Being from Delhi, I truly missed the family tradition of visiting a Gurudwara together on this auspicious day to seek Baba Nanak’s blessings. However, owing to my posting in Mumbai, I visited alone this time — yet the divine vibrations and calmness made me feel spiritually connected and content.

Located conveniently near Dadar Station and not far from my residence, the Gurudwara is easily accessible and offers a perfect place for inner peace amidst the city’s rush. The entire experience was heartwarming and uplifting — a true reminder of Guru Nanak Dev Ji’s eternal message of peace, humility, and service.

A must-visit place in Mumbai, especially on Gurupurab, for anyone seeking divine calm and soulful connection. 🙏

featured_reviews.name: Rosy Kohli
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had been there on 17,18,19 th June 2022,for Paavan Prakash Purab Sri Guru Hargobind Ji Maharaj Ji .
My brother had kept Akhand Path Sahib Ji due to the rainy season it was difficult 54.3 KM travel Up & down .My Daddy ji was a member of Sewak Jatha Dadar used to always Keep Akhand Path when he was alive so my brother kept this time ,We are lucky we got one room to stay my brother &my son ,I was there .The room was big with a double bed & single bed attached, toilet & bathroom.
After years ,I had been here  while .When I stayed there I got to know how they help people not only Sikh community but others also .In my 3 days stay at Gurudwara with my brother in one room only came to know so much.

As you enter at day time a papaji ( Old person ) who has a big smile greets  people. But people tell him arrogant when he says the room is not  available ,
There are rooms but most are occupied by cancer patients they keep 2 rooms for Ragi jatha ( who sings Hyms) when they come from outside Mumbai  stay here doing kirtan.
Thanks to Balbir Singh & Harbhajan Singh from Sewak Jatha Dadar knew my Daddy ji so  I had few questions about people staying here so I asked them they told me,
There is a Dormitory ( big room with single bed & locker ) for cancer patients they charge just 100 rs they  go to common toilet bathroom these patients visit Tata Memorial hospital daily which near to Gurudwara these people come from different states around India Dr call them for check up ,first then they have do different Test hospital don't allow to stay at hospital they can't afford to stay in hotel so they stay here. Some stay for 3-4 days some stay for week till treatment get over.Here first come first no booking of room are done in advance nor money is taken in advance.

These & other cancer patients are given early morning Tea, Breakfast,Lunch, Evening Tea snacks, Dinner . If Dr tells patients to have some soup or Dal water pantry is there they can make it if they can't make it so sevadaar( Volunteer who  give free service there )  help them ,make give to the patients.

There is a small  Dormitory where students stay they come from different places for competitive exams and can stay for 1 day for Admission stay here only for 2-3 days .
When rooms are not there they say no to tourists they shout,sometimes abuse the staff members also.If crowd is not there some times staff guide them to near by guest house or at Chunabhatti were rooms are available but people don't want to go there because from this place tourist can to Mumbai.
Gurudwara committee members try their level best to help people during covid time also those who were inside was given food they also arrange vehicle so people could reach safely at there home .
I remember there was an article even Gurudwara money was in PMC bank but still people staying near by
came forward and donated also  and made langar was given to people daily during lockdown . They told with blessings of waheguru ji people used to send Atta,Rice, vegetables ,dal we could serve people in lockdown, General public was not allowed.They made food packets to everyone .Even Mumbai police used to have langar .
Gurudwara organizes Gurpurab & with Sewak Jatha Dadar , youngsters come forward to help them. Everyone is assigned with their duty they do it nicely.

Now renovation work is going on People come forward and give donations to Gurudwara they get rebate Income Tax .

The Gurudwara is easily seen from road. The don't have ramp but next door u have climb 3-4 step holding steel rod from there lift entrance is there.♿  The place is not accessible. But they have wheel chairs they help people get on wheels chairs in Gurudwara.

featured_reviews.name: Himanshu Jhunjhunwala
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Divine Place of Peace, Seva, and Compassion

Four Bungalows Gurudwara in Andheri West is truly one of the most peaceful and spiritual places in Mumbai. The atmosphere here is filled with positivity and calmness — every visit brings a sense of inner peace and gratitude.

What makes this Gurudwara even more special is its continuous Langar Seva, served twice daily, 365 days a year, feeding thousands of people selflessly. The management and volunteers work with so much dedication and humility — a true example of Guru Nanak Dev Ji’s teachings of Seva (selfless service) and Sarbat da Bhala (well-being of all).

Their recent initiative of adopting three flood-affected villages in Punjab and helping families with seeds, diesel, and essentials shows how deeply this Gurudwara believes in serving humanity beyond boundaries.

Truly a sacred place where peace meets purpose. Grateful to the entire Suri family and the management for keeping the spirit of Seva alive every single day.

featured_reviews.name: Surjeet Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Divine and Soulful Experience at Gurudwara Shri Dashmesh Darbar

Visiting Gurudwara Shri Dashmesh Darbar was a truly spiritual and heartwarming experience. The moment I stepped inside, I was embraced by an atmosphere of peace, devotion, and selfless service.

The prayer hall is beautifully maintained, resonating with the soothing sounds of Gurbani Kirtan that fill the space with positivity and tranquility. The aura of the Gurudwara is incredibly uplifting, making it an ideal place for prayer, meditation, and inner reflection.

The langar (community kitchen) is another highlight—serving delicious, simple, and nourishing meals to all, regardless of caste, creed, or background. The sense of equality and service is truly inspiring, as the volunteers work with devotion and kindness, ensuring everyone feels welcomed and cared for.

What stands out most about Gurudwara Shri Dashmesh Darbar is its deep-rooted commitment to seva (selfless service) and community well-being. Whether it's through feeding the needy, organizing charitable initiatives, or simply providing a peaceful sanctuary for worshippers, this Gurudwara embodies the true spirit of Sikhism.

If you are in Mumbai and looking for a place to find spiritual solace, peace, and community warmth, I highly recommend visiting Gurudwara Shri Dashmesh Darbar. It is more than just a place of worship—it is a place of love, unity, and divine blessings. 🙏✨

featured_reviews.name: Kirtan Chavda
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visiting Gurudwara Sri Dashmesh Darbar is a truly peaceful and uplifting experience. The place welcomes everyone, regardless of background, and offers daily langar (free meals) that brings the community together. The positive vibes, the kindness of volunteers, and the sense of belonging make it a must-visit spot for anyone seeking comfort or spiritual calm.

Most active gurudwara I've visited.

featured_reviews.name: Rajveer Singh RV
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had the most incredible experience at Gurudwara Dashmesh Darbar in GTB Nagar, Mumbai! The moment I stepped inside, I was enveloped in a sense of tranquility and serenity that I've never felt before. The warm welcome and hospitality from the devotees and staff were heartwarming.

The atmosphere inside the Gurudwara was filled with devotion and spirituality, instantly making me feel at peace. The sacred hymns and prayers filled the air, creating an aura of positivity that's truly indescribable. It felt like a sanctuary for the soul.

The Langar (community kitchen) was a unique and humbling experience. The selfless service of the volunteers providing delicious meals to everyone, regardless of their background, left me feeling incredibly blessed and grateful.

Every aspect of Gurudwara Dashmesh Darbar exudes a sense of unity, love, and compassion. The teachings and principles followed here are truly inspiring. It's a place where people from all walks of life can come together and find solace.

If you're seeking guaranteed peace of mind and a feeling of being blessed, I wholeheartedly recommend visiting Gurudwara Dashmesh Darbar in GTB Nagar, Mumbai. It's an experience that will touch your heart and leave a lasting impact on your soul..

customer_updates.name: Rosy Kohli
customer_updates.text:
Celebrating 552nd GURPURAB
SAHIB SRI GURU NANAK DEV JI, after lockdown today we celebrate the Prakash Purab, due to pandemic no one was allowed to go to Gurdware only people staying there inside would do prayers. But Langer( food) was made daily was served twice afternoon & night in lockdown . Taking all safety precautions food packets were given my tailor told me as no work, due to lockdown he used have food here every day, near by people staying in slum would come,take langar packets auto wala today told me mam there no passenger people were not moving in out in lockdown,it was difficult, but we got food from Sikh Gurdware, they serve us with smile face we used stand in queue wearing mask . I said yes most of Gurdware in Mumbai served langar
Today felt happy after years we got to celebrate with Grace of God all program went smoothly. Some were wearing mask some removed when entered inside . But I took all safety measures wore mask, during the whole program,had Langar left.And prayed 🙏to babaji bless everyone is safe and we living normal life.

featured_reviews.name: Harshal Kadu
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dhan Guru Nanak Dev Ji Maharaj. Every visit to this Gurudwara fills the heart with peace and positivity. The divine atmosphere, soulful Gurbani, and selfless seva create a truly blessed experience. Thank you to all the sevadars who work tirelessly to maintain this sacred place. Waheguru Ji bless everyone. 🙏🏻

The Gurudwara is located at Khar West, Mumbai and is highly rated by visitors for its cleanliness, peaceful environment, and langar seva.

featured_reviews.name: Anil Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very well maintained, neat and well kept Gurudwara. There is not a speck of dust and dirt anywhere and even the carpets were very well kept.
The darbar sahab was very serene and calming. Marble inlay work is there on the boundry wall of the gurudwara.

featured_reviews.name: Sahaj Umang Singh Bhatia
featured_reviews.review_text:
Peaceful, well organised environs with very helpful and supportive Sevadars.

Sangat should use public transport since street parking can congest the road.

featured_reviews.name: Gurpreet Singh
featured_reviews.review_text: Gurudwara is one of the best place to find peace and calm your mind. I always visited in morning and evening for enchanting of Gurbani and Simran.

featured_reviews.name: Rosy Kohli
featured_reviews.review_text:
It's is one of oldest Gurudware of Mumbai,my Anand karaj (Marriage Ceremony) was done, here 25 years ago.There are many changes done by Gurudware committee like putting lift inside the Gurudwara to help senior citizen & it help's handicap people come to Gurudwara & attend daily prayer's .
Ac are put inside & Down hall also.
Every day morning & evening people come to listen prayers.
Ladies on Monday do Prayers & kirtan.
Gurpurb are celebrate many people attend langar is prepared & served in the hall.
The Gurudwara is walking distance from khar station & S.V road bus stop.
One should visit take blessings of Guru Granth Saibh.
Only cover your head ,Wash your hand.
People who drink ,eat tobacco ,smoke is not allowed .
You should keep your Mobile on silent mode.

featured_reviews.name: Kirtan Chavda
featured_reviews.review_text:
I've visited on Monday, 16th June 2025 in evening time, at around 19:50 I reached. When I reached it was prayer time and its almost end of the prayer, lady devotee was singing some prayers beautifully. After prayers there's a prasad (langar) which is so delicious and authentic.

Gurudwara is just 5 mins walking from Khar road railway station platform number 1A (West side). Gurudwara is peaceful and calm. Also cleanliness is top class. Prayer hall and langar (Dinning) hall is soo specious. Shoe house is allocated to keep footwears safely. Although its nearest to the railway station area still Washroom and surrounding was properly clean and hygienic.

Entrance gate is constructed of white marbles and the ambiance was so good. Vibe was good.

PS. No pictures is taken.
